Balanced across nine donors the strongest competitor never exceeds ceil(k/9): one instance up to rho 0.30, two at 0.40 and 0.49. Converting each declared level to the concentrated rate posing the same decision gives 0.036 / 0.040 / 0.045 / 0.100 / 0.118 -- the nominal axis spans 4.9x, the effective axis spans 3.3x and never exceeds 12%. Worse, rho 0.10, 0.20 and 0.30 all leave the strongest competitor at exactly one instance, so three of the five rungs are the same experiment, which is why the floor curve read non-monotone. The axis therefore tests robustness to diluted evidence and cannot reach ambiguous evidence at any declared rate; raising rho does not fix it, because while the donors are balanced the ratio never falls below 7:1. One donor per bag makes the five rungs distinct and makes NOISE_CAP = 0.5 correct for the reason its own docstring already gives. The operator chose the tie: forcing the error is the intent. The tie forces an error only if the pairing is an involution -- with a long cycle the unordered pair identifies the label and a model learns the rule instead, scoring 100% -- so the pairing is five mutual pairs, derived from confusability in the data rather than from a prior about which digits look alike. The decision a bag poses is its own class against the strongest single competitor and never against the summed contaminant count, and balanced across nine donors that competitor never exceeds ceil(k/9): one instance up to rho 0.30, two at 0.40. The old ladder's hardest rung was therefore 18 against 2, and the axis measured robustness to DILUTED evidence while being unable to reach ambiguous evidence at any admitted rate. Raising rho cannot fix it: while the donors are balanced the ratio never falls below 7:1.

`NOISE_PAIRING` is an involution on the ten classes with no fixed point -- five mutual pairs -- and it is DERIVED from confusability in the data rather than chosen from a prior about which digits look alike, and never from a trained model, because a declaration must not depend on a run. Two independent class-centroid cosine proxies: raw pixels exactly as the bags hand them to the encoder, which needs no model at all, and the declared backbone's untrained ImageNet features, which is closer to what the encoder sees but inherits the backbone choice. Each is normalized per domain and averaged over the three, and the matching is solved exactly by enumerating all 945 perfect matchings on ten classes. The two proxies disagree on their own optimum, so neither alone is defensible: the backbone proxy's winner falls to rank 754 of 945 under pixels, and declaring it would have declared the proxy instead of the confusability. The averaged optimum -- 0-6, 1-4, 2-8, 3-5, 7-9 -- is the only matching near-optimal under both, at ranks 2 and 19 of 945, and it stays rank 2 under pixels alone, which matters because that proxy needs no backbone while three are declared. It carries the two most confusable pairs of the averaged matrix, 3-5 at 0.0546 and 7-9.

The declared levels are 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 and the tie at 15 of `INSTANCES_PER_BAG`, which under one donor is 15 instances of the bag's own class against 15 of its declared partner. The top rung forces an error by construction and that is the intent, not a side effect: under a mutual pairing a bag labelled a and a bag labelled its partner have IDENTICAL class composition and two different labels, so any composition reader -- which is what a bag-unit arm is -- gets exactly one of the pair right. The involution is what makes that true, and it is why the pairing may not be a long cycle: there the unordered pair identifies the label, so a model learns the pairing and scores 100% on the one rung that exists to be undecidable. `NOISE_CAP` stays at 0.5 and its own stated reason becomes exact rather than approximate -- past the cap the donor class is the plurality and the bag's label stops being defensible -- where under the balanced draw that reason held for the wrong quantity, since the plurality there only broke at rho 0.90.

The tie's ceiling is derived per (domain, seed) and travels with the result, never written down as a constant: for each mutual pair a composition reader can get at most max(n_a, n_b) of that pair's n_a + n_b evaluation bags, and the figure ranges 0.5000 to 0.5556 across the domains and seeds because the evaluation split is drawn from a seeded generator. Every table that prints the top rung carries its own derived ceiling beside it, because a number read against 1.0000 there reports a failure where the method is in fact at 85% of what is attainable -- which makes the omission misleading by construction rather than merely incomplete.

The levels are 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 and 0.4, capped there. With 30 instances and contaminants drawn from the other nine classes the drawn class stays the plurality while rho is below 0.5; past that the bag label stops being defensible and the curve measures nothing.

The declared levels are 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 and the tie at 15 of `INSTANCES_PER_BAG`, which under one donor is 15 instances of the bag's own class against 15 of its declared partner. The top rung forces an error by construction and that is the intent, not a side effect: under a mutual pairing a bag labelled a and a bag labelled its partner have IDENTICAL class composition and two different labels, so any composition reader -- which is what a bag-unit arm is -- gets exactly one of the pair right. The involution is what makes that true, and it is why the pairing may not be a long cycle: there the unordered pair identifies the label, so a model learns the pairing and scores 100% on the one rung that exists to be undecidable. `NOISE_CAP` stays at 0.5 and its own stated reason becomes exact rather than approximate -- past the cap the donor class is the plurality and the bag's label stops being defensible -- where under the balanced draw that reason held for the wrong quantity, since the plurality there only broke at rho 0.90.

`NOISE_PAIRING` is an involution on the ten classes with no fixed point -- five mutual pairs -- and it is DERIVED from confusability in the data rather than chosen from a prior about which digits look alike, and never from a trained model, because a declaration must not depend on a run. Two independent class-centroid cosine proxies: raw pixels exactly as the bags hand them to the encoder, which needs no model at all, and the declared backbone's untrained ImageNet features, which is closer to what the encoder sees but inherits the backbone choice. Each is normalized per domain and averaged over the three, and the matching is solved exactly by enumerating all 945 perfect matchings on ten classes. The two proxies disagree on their own optimum, so neither alone is defensible: the backbone proxy's winner falls to rank 754 of 945 under pixels, and declaring it would have declared the proxy instead of the confusability. The averaged optimum -- 0-6, 1-4, 2-8, 3-5, 7-9 -- is the only matching near-optimal under both, at ranks 2 and 19 of 945, and it stays rank 2 under pixels alone, which matters because that proxy needs no backbone while three are declared. It carries the two most confusable pairs of the averaged matrix, 3-5 at 0.0546 and 7-9.

Contamination draws every replacement in a bag from ONE donor class -- the class `NOISE_PAIRING` declares for that bag's own label -- instead of balancing them across the other nine. The decision a bag poses is its own class against the strongest single competitor and never against the summed contaminant count, and balanced across nine donors that competitor never exceeds ceil(k/9): one instance up to rho 0.30, two at 0.40. The old ladder's hardest rung was therefore 18 against 2, and the axis measured robustness to DILUTED evidence while being unable to reach ambiguous evidence at any admitted rate. Converted to the concentrated rate posing the same decision, the old levels are 0.036, 0.040, 0.045, 0.100 and 0.118: the nominal axis spans 4.9x while the effective one never exceeds 12%, and rho 0.10, 0.20 and 0.30 are one experiment repeated three times because each leaves the strongest competitor at exactly one instance -- which is why the floor's own curve read non-monotone. Raising rho cannot fix it: while the donors are balanced the ratio never falls below 7:1.

The tie's ceiling is derived per (domain, seed) and travels with the result, never written down as a constant: for each mutual pair a composition reader can get at most max(n_a, n_b) of that pair's n_a + n_b evaluation bags, and the figure ranges 0.5000 to 0.5556 across the domains and seeds because the evaluation split is drawn from a seeded generator.
